programme.title: Veerkrag

programme.title: Ons Gesels Troues

programme.desc: 'S5/E2'. Marlo Minnaar is 'n mentor wat stories aan die brand kan steek met net 'n kyk. Sy span is Moya Erasmus, net 17 jaar oud, en Eduard de Villiers, wat jou verwagtings kom ruk.

programme.desc: 'S2/E4'. Doreen Morris ondersoek die onopgeloste sake van Suid-Afrika se vermistes. Sy ontmoet naasbestaandes en ontsyfer hul vermiste geliefdes se doen en late voor die verdwyning.

programme.desc: 'S16/E10 - Mystery Of The Stone Spheres'. There are mysterious ancient stones shaped into perfect spheres. Many of them show clear evidence of being manmade and some completely defy explanation.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S16/E11 - The Lost City Of The Maya'. Considered by many to be the greatest civilization in the history of the Americas, the Maya thrived for more than 2,000 years.

programme.title: Britain's Murder Map With Vicky...
programme.desc: 'Britain's Murder Map With Vicky Mcclure And Jonny Owen. S1/E4 - Kelso Cochrane'. Vicky and Jonny go back to Notting Hill in 1959 to examine how racial tensions in the area lead to Antiguan carpenter's murder.

programme.title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Engineering Disasters'. It takes just a little carelessness to trigger the deadliest engineering failures in history.

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - The Beginning'. In September 1939, enabled by a secret pact between Adolf Hitler and Josef Stalin, Germany invades Poland with its lightning style of tank warfare, plunging Europe back into war.

programme.title: The Last Burma Star
programme.desc: To mark the 80th anniversary of VJ Day, explorer Levison Wood and historian Alex Bescoby set out on an urgent mission to honour the last surviving veterans of the Burma Campaign.

programme.title: Deadman's Curse
programme.desc: 'S3/E3 - The Legend Of The Lost Spanish Mound'. Is Slumach's gold buried along with the bodies of slaughtered Spanish Conquistadors? Legends collide when Adam leads the team 200 km east to B.C.'s Similkameen Valley.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S8/E40 of 50 - 200th Episode: Fans' Choice'. To celebrate 200 episodes, we're handing control over to the people who got us here - our fans. Which smith will rise to this momentous occasion and leave the forge with $10,000?

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S8/E43 of 50 - The Firangi Sword'. Four bladesmiths are given just one simple task: impress the judges. The most impressive smith, and one other who survives the testing, will return home to recreate the Indian Firangi Sword.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: 'S24/E21 - Jumpin' Jake Flash'. A set of replica Muppets has Chum green with envy. When a pair of pants supposedly worn by Keith Richards rolls into the shop, Corey teaches Jake you can't always get what you want.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S10/E24 - 666 The Sign Of The Profit'. Not even the 'cupped hands' of San Bernardino can save Mary's fortune, but Ivy manages to scrap together a bit of coin, while Kenny finds all the magic.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S10/E25 - Tour de Chance'. The girls have a newlywed-themed surprise for Emily. Rene reels in a huge locker, while Darrell tests his bicycle knowledge... and wins.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S10/E26 - The Wild Wild Vests'. The oldest facility in Los Angeles is where the newest buyers make their debut. Brandi and Jarrod try to piece their way to a win.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: 'S12/E4 - Enemy Roads'. Todd hauls a massive machine as he fights his way home in a final showdown with his nemesis - the infamous Asheweig Road. After a risky brake fix during her longest run of her season.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: 'S25/E5 - Boyz II Pawn Stars'. Rick swings for the fences on some major league memorabilia from one of baseball's best. Corey and Chum go to the end of the road authenticating a Boyz II Men jacket.

programme.title: Secrets In The Sand
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Atacama Alien & Chimu Child Sacrifice'. In Chile's Atacama Desert, a mysterious six-inch skeleton sparks debate over alien origins. Deep in the Gobi Desert, ruins of Khara-Khoto reveal a vanished Silk Road civilization.

programme.title: Secrets In The Sand
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - Million Mummy Necropolis & The Enigmatic Horseshoe'. An ancient cemetery in Egypt yields over a million naturally preserved burials. In France, a horseshoe-shaped monument reveals links to ancient weaponry and ritual.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Shall We Go On'. Germany continues to build its empire in Europe, occupying Poland, Czechoslovakia, Austria, Luxembourg, Norway, Denmark, The Netherlands and Belgium.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Infamy'. The United Kingdom is isolated as German forces occupy Europe. 17,000 Trains carry German armies towards the Soviet Union. With Operation Barbarossa Hitler launches Vernichtungskrieg, a war of annihilation.

programme.title: Trace, Track, Get My Car Back
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. A family car fitted with a child seat is stolen by thieves. Tracker Richard is hot on their heels but there's a setback when the thieves discover the hidden tracking device.

programme.title: IGNITION GT
programme.desc: 'S26/E21'. Changan expand their local product offering with the Uni-S. We find out what's in store from JMC and Juliet samples Chery's new Tiggo 9 flagship.

programme.title: Cape Route Rally
programme.desc: 'S1/E13'. Classic cars, 26 scenic mountain passes, wine farms, epic views, and even a helicopter chase. A celebration of motoring passion, people, and pure driving joy.

programme.title: Just To See How Far It Is
programme.desc: 'S2/E12'. From rocking it in Rondavel to wild camping on the river, supping with shepherds and crossing the highest dam in Africa, it's hard not to fall in love with the Kingdom in the sky.

programme.title: Auto Mundial
programme.desc: 'S26/E21'. We find out what happens to old EV batteries, how cars power the AI boom, final tests before BMW unveils the new 3 Series, and Ducati reveals its arguably prettiest bike yet today.

programme.title: Rev
programme.desc: 'S26/E21'. From military sites to everyday roads, connected cars raise new security questions. Europe is looking for rules instead of bans. REV puts the MG S6 through its electric paces.

programme.title: Asian Le Mans Series
